title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 13
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q121_hits_out_at
elements.title: In an interview, the director ___ the proposed cuts, describing them as reckless and unfair.

elements.name: q122_turn_a_blind_eye

elements.name: q123_authoritarian_turn

elements.name: q124_stuck
elements.title: The drawer was ___ and would not move at all.

elements.name: q125_head_back

elements.name: q126_grueling_gruelling

elements.name: q127_resurrect
elements.title: The community plans to ___ the festival after years without one.

elements.name: q128_moral_obligation

elements.name: q129_bamboozled

elements.name: q130_a_whole_lot
